extracted.name: Cherry smoothie
extracted.description: Try using frozen cherries for ease to make this vibrant smoothie. Serve on its own or with brunch. Kids will love it, too
instruction_lines: Tip all the ingredients into a blender and blitz until smooth. Adjust the thickness to your liking with 50-100ml cold water. Serve in four glasses or chill for up to 24 hrs, giving a good stir before serving.
